notes: The complete 52-function Memory Master scene/factory run is reconstructed as one dScMgMemory2_c C++ translation unit. Address-only behavior is attached to class members. Main, result, round and card tables use typed member pointers; player-table ownership follows the initializer evidence below. The 0x270 shared state has compiler-owned destruction, and the header exposes scene/card/player/cursor fields. Some legacy loop views remain; this is not a claim that the entire class is fully reconstructed.

PMF ownership evidence: __sinit_ov006_021314e4 builds main StateSetup/StatePlay/StateJudge/StateResult/StateExit, result ResultWait/ResultReward/ResultTurnCards/ResultFinish, card CardMove/CardIdle/CardSelect/CardFlipUp/CardWait/CardFlipDown/CardFlyAway, and player PlayerDrop/PlayerMove/PlayerWait tables. Its ten-entry round table independently fixes RoundStart through RoundReveal order.

COINED NAMES: the 43 handler/helper ROM symbols were address-only, so no recovered spelling exists to confirm or contradict the descriptive names in functions[]. The ROM proves dScMgMemory2_c ownership and the PMF tables prove state-group identities; exact original source spellings are disclosed as unknown here and in symbols/actor_renames.tsv.

The scene factory now uses ordinary new dScMgMemory2_c. Declaring the existing Particle::SysTracker constructor and initializing the real shared-state member preserve both observed component calls and the exact96-byte factory under2004/b56. All52 licensed bodies and13 complete metadata records match; emission order is unchanged. Two additional,unreferenced compiler-emitted destructor bodies have exact-symbol deadstrip policies below. The earlier64-byte direct-new probe omitted component initialization and is retained only as a historical incomplete experiment,not as an equivalent-form compiler constraint. See notes/experiments/pr2875-integration-0920.json for the complete construction proof.

FACTORY RELOCATION PROOF: native references to the dScMgMemory2_c and dScMgSingle3DBase_c vtables use the ABI two-word preamble (+8). Existing objisolate normalization resolves these to their canonical ROM slot-array targets. The former literal base-vtable view used addend0 against its external public-symbol convention. Fresh strict verification proves all52 licensed bodies and actual relocation destinations; complete raw object identity with the literal factory is not claimed.

CURRENT NON-TEXT BOUNDARY: this promotion owns the complete contiguous .text run only. The PMF tables, resource/static data, compiler-generated RTTI/vtable, __sinit_ov006_021314e4 and 0x021423a8..0x02142490 BSS remain ROM-gap owned until their exact input-section order and initializers are reconstructed.

PROMOTED to src/minigames/d_s_mg_memory2.cpp. The whole 52-function run moves as one unit -- no subset was taken: the cartridge orders D1 (0x020f5564) BELOW D0 (0x020f55b8), the reproducible direction, and delinks.txt carries no coverage hole across 0x020f5564..0x020f7634, so nothing forces a cut. Placement follows notes/agents/roles/writer.md's fixed convention (src/actors/<Class>.cpp) and the same-overlay pipeline precedent src/minigames/d_s_mg_d3d_base.cpp, superseding the pre-promotion plan's src/minigames/d_s_mg_memory2.cpp; the thirteen sibling d_s_mg_*.cpp files predate that convention.

COMPILER-ONLY OUTPUT:13 data policies and 2 exact-symbol deadstrip function policies, 15 rows total. The six-class chain dScMgMemory2_c -> dScMgSingle3DBase_c -> dScMgBase_c -> dScene_c -> dBase_c -> fBase_c gives 2x6 typeinfo rows plus 1 vtable. The function policies cover the existing dScMgMemory2_c D2 and the additional dScMgSingle3DBase_c D2 emitted by ordinary construction. The former dMgMemory2SharedState_c D1 policy went when that wrapper became a typed Dealer member: Dealer's constructor and destructor are declared only, and their ROM homes are in ov006/unit020bfec0. Each has no configured ROM home and no retained relocation references it. The queue row records the ancestry-derived minimum of13 compiler-only data records; it is not a total of all function policies.

EMISSION ORDER WITHOUT REVERSING THE SOURCE. This TU is written ROM-ASCENDING and still emits ROM-ascending, because `#pragma defer_codegen off` (after the includes and the extern block) makes mwccarm 2004/b56 emit each definition as it is encountered instead of deferring and reversing. That is what keeps the two file-local optimisation pragmas -- opt_propagation off around DrawCards and opt_loop_invariants off around ResultFinish, each bracketed #pragma push/pop -- attached to the members that measured them, and it is why the out-of-line destructor here yields licensed D1-then-D0 rather than the D2/D0/D1 the deferred path gives.

The handwritten src/unnamed/ov006/__sinit_ov006_021314e4.c initializer folded into this TU as the six retail-ordered table definitions at its end: the 23-entry sprite-pointer permutation and the five PMF state tables (5 main, 10 round, 4 result, 7 card, 3 player) defined through the existing dScMgMemory2_cState/dScMgMemory2_cCardState typedefs and plain-copied from the still-extern .data descriptor records. mwcc emits the same 0x3bc initializer into .init (36 literal-pool reloc sites matching retail), the same .ctor word, and per-table .bss sections covering 0x021423a8..0x021424ec; no @NNN temps are emitted. Same shape as sibling d_s_mg_memory.cpp (READY row 73).
